study_area: Klang Valley core: Kuala Lumpur federal territory, Putrajaya federal territory, and 6 urbanised Selangor districts (Gombak, Hulu Langat, Klang, Kuala Langat, Petaling, Sepang). Deliberately excludes rural/exurban Selangor (Sabak Bernam, Hulu Selangor, etc.).

qoe_formula.note: qoe_index = w_dl*min(100, log1p(dl)/log1p(50)*100) + w_ul*min(100, log1p(ul)/log1p(20)*100) - w_rtt*100*(1-exp(-max(0,rtt-20)/50)) - w_loss*100*(1-exp(-max(0,loss)/3)), clipped to [0,100]. This is a custom composite index inspired by Weber-Fechner perceptual scaling, NOT a validated ITU-T G.107 E-model — see qoe_target.py's own docstring.

disclaimer: The hourly QoE panel (cell_time_dataset) is a simulated diurnal-demand scenario built on top of 100% real static GIS features (towers, buildings, roads, POIs, population) — it is a software-integration and dashboard-demo fixture, not observed network measurements. 60.0% of cells have their simulated values re-centred on a real quarterly Ookla average; the rest are simulated-only. See cell_static_qoe_baseline.parquet for the zero-synthetic-QoE real Ookla baseline.
